inputTimingFailure.resolution: A normal level choice opened while presenting touch cancel. The verifier now resolves visible choices before the separate aim tap. Runtime assets did not change.

researchStrategyFailure.resolution: The initial eight normal runs did not select and exercise the required tide evolution. The verifier prioritizes preserving 21 luck and uses previously earned coins for visible weapon/wall purchases; acceptance assertions and runtime are unchanged.

desktopInterruption.reason: Process terminated by signal; origin not established. No OOM event found in kernel log.

landscapeResearchFailure.resolution: Same required-evolution failure under the earlier selection strategy; rerun with legal growth and preservation of luck.

supersededWeixinRun.reason: Superseded the still-running old selection strategy after the same strategy failed required tide evolution in two Web cases. Restart with the fully passed legal-growth strategy.

terrainReference.scope: Offline reference evidence only. Gameplay, stage availability and original terrain collision/trigger dispatch remain incomplete.
